name: Necromancer: Crypt Fiends attack with Frozen Barbs and Skeletal Archers with Skeletal Arrow (#5692)
contract: Live CoA combat logs (C:/CoA/SUB/old-logs, 160 logs, 2026-06 to 2026-09) show Crypt Fiend 50323 attacking with SPELL_CAST_START 803406 'Frozen Barbs' ('Summons several crypt scarabs to attack the caster's target', 3 s cast, SpellVisual 989936 whose missile is 'Missile: Crypt Scarab') and Skeletal Archer 50076 attacking with 800609 'Skeletal Arrow' (27238 casts, bow weapon damage, SpellVisual 989928). 801516 'Command: Skeletal Archer' never appears in those logs, and 822074 'Frost-Congealed Barbs' (Rank 'Command: Crypt Fiends') starts only when every Crypt Fiend fires it at the same moment. AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp AttackSpell(entry) fed the periodic 3 s attack loop with the Command spells 822074 and 801516, so the minions showed frost bolts and shadow bolts instead of scarabs and arrows. After one Command: Undead sets their victim, the fixed minions keep casting 803406 and 800609 on their own, and the Command spells fire only for the Command itself.
